narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The ant goes up three and then across six, so the path is nine centimetres.
<bookmark mark='cut'/>His path turns a corner on the flat net.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Cutting straight across the corner is always shorter.
